$comment: Every *.test.ts / *.test.tsx file under apps/*/src and packages/*/src is discovered
automatically. A file lands in the FIRST tier whose `match` globs it; anything
unmatched falls into `defaultTier`. New test files therefore run with no edits here.
To stop a file running you must add it to `exclusions` WITH a reason — the runner
fails if an exclusion has no reason, or if an exclusion no longer matches any file.

tiers.name: network
tiers.description: Reaches hosts outside the runner: live Vercel API, SSH, remote registries. Long timeouts.

tiers.name: browser
tiers.description: Drives a real Chromium instance via Playwright. Needs browsers installed.

tiers.name: integration
tiers.description: Needs a live backing service (Postgres, Redis, Qdrant).

tiers.name: unit
tiers.description: Deterministic, no network, no external services. The CI gate.

$tierNotes: `browser` and `integration` have empty `match` lists on purpose.
Audited at b54f389: ORVYN has no test FILE that is wholly service-dependent.
Service-dependent CASES live inside otherwise-deterministic files and gate themselves
— e.g. PostgresAuthStorage.test.ts uses { skip: !integration } driven by ORVYN_PG_URL.
node:test reports those as skipped and the runner surfaces them as SKIPPED, never passed.
Those same files are re-run with ORVYN_PG_URL set against a real postgres:16 service by
.github/workflows/postgres-production-mirror.yml. That is the live integration tier today
and it is deliberate, not duplicate execution: the unit run exercises the deterministic
cases, the mirror run exercises the gated ones.
Populate these `match` lists when a genuinely service-only test FILE is added.

acceptance.description: Real GUI / live-environment acceptance. Separate scripts, not node:test files.

$exclusionNotes: Empty on purpose. Audited at b54f389: no ORVYN test file should be prevented from running.
The previous root `npm test` allowlist silently omitted 26 files; all 26 now execute.
apps/desktop/tsconfig.json excludes src/renderer/**/*.test.ts from the tsc BUILD only;
those files still execute here via node --experimental-strip-types.
To exclude a file from execution add { path, reason, owner, reviewBy }. The runner fails
the build if an exclusion has no reason, or if it points at a file that no longer exists.
